caption.body:
Export finance: where to look before you take your first big order.

Good orders still need cash to fulfil. Start by talking to your bank about pre-shipment finance, and ask what documents it will need. Look at ECGC for export credit insurance against buyer non-payment, and read what EXIM Bank and SIDBI currently offer. If you are new, DGFT's Niryat Bandhu programme offers training and mentoring.

Products, limits and eligibility change, so always check the official websites and the bank's current terms before you apply.
